capabilities: Log workout sets from a calendar
Create custom exercises organized by muscle group
Track kilograms and reps, reps only, minutes and kilometers, or seconds
Save workouts as Markdown files in a vault folder
disambiguation: Not a learning or flashcard trainer; it is a workout log.
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no data; changing the storage folder does not move existing files; physical mobile devices have not been tested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record workout sessions, exercises and sets over time.
summary: Local workout journal that logs exercises and sets on a calendar and saves each session as a Markdown note.
